 K-pop group BIGBANG releases new single to celebrate their 20th anniversary.
 The release of the new single comes as BIGBANG is on their “XX: Cosmos” world tour, part of their 20th anniversary celebrations.
 VietnamPlus • 20/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 On November 20th, K-pop group BIGBANG will release a new digital single, continuing their activities marking 20 years since their debut.
 YG Entertainment has released promotional posters for their new release on their official blog. However, details regarding the song have yet to be revealed.
 According to the plan, the single will be officially released at 2 PM on November 20th ( Korean time).
 This is BIGBANG's latest musical release following their song " BiiiG " which was released in August.
 Previously, " BiiiG " was the group's first new song in over four years since the release of their single "Still Life" in April 2022.
 The release of the new single comes as BIGBANG is on their “XX: Cosmos” world tour, part of their 20th anniversary celebrations. 
 In addition, the group is also scheduled to perform at the MAMA Awards ceremony held in Osaka, Japan, this weekend.
 Through the release of new music and the continuation of large-scale performances, BIGBANG continues to promote its celebration of two decades in the K-pop music industry.
